book.title: Malobhi Manyahi ngati moghalembakike na Luka

content: Ulenganesu waka mlonda wanga wambone

Yesu akabhapwaghi bhabhulwa bhaki ulenganesu agho, “Pakabhi na mwanahindu yamaheli jumu joakabhi na mlonda wa hindu yaki. Bhandu bhakunchochaki mwanahindu hoju kubha mlonda waki apechangana hindu yaki liyaha.

Bhela mwana hindu jola akunkemiki na kumpwaghila, ‘Bho, hagha malobhi bholi ghanyowana panani jako? Nukujopa ubhalanga hindu yangu yokapi yeujopiki na yeubhohiki, maghambu ngacheupalika kabheti kujendalela kubha wa mlonda wa hindu yangu.’
Mlonda jola akaliholalili, ‘Nkolongwa wangu anandopula lihengu la kujemalela. Henu anandenda kike? Ngachemili na makili gha kulemela, na kujenda kujopajopa mona hiyoni.
Henu nikimanyi chembalika kuchihenga, nahuli anandopuliki lihengu langu, bhandu bhaweza kunyopalela kunyumba jabhu.’
“Bhela akabhakemiti bhokapi bhabhadaiwa na bambo waki. Akundaluki wa kutumbula, ‘Bho, bambo wangu akudai mbija ilenga?’
Jombi akamuyangiki, ‘Mapipa mia moja gha mahuta gha mizeituni.’ Mlonda jola akumpwaghile, ‘Utola cheti chaku cha lideni, utama pahi na ulemba mapipa hamsini.’
Bhela akundaluki na jongi, ‘Wenga akudai kike?’ Na jombi akamuyangiki, ‘Magunila mia moja gha ingano.’ Mlonda jola akumpwaghile, ‘Utola cheti chaku cha lideni, na ulemba magunila semanini.’ ”

“Bhela bambo waka mlonda jola akundumbali mlonda muhakau ndandi akahengiki kila chindu kwa kuchenjela. Maghambu bhandu bha pundema pani bhachenjili nakanopi mukuhenga mambu ghabhu kupeta bhandu bha unang'anu.”
Yesu akajendali kupwagha, “Nanatu numpwaghila, ntumila hindu ya pundema pani kwa kulonda bhakochi, nahuli payanjomukya, muweza kujopalewa munyumba ja womi wa mileli.

Jokapi joakubha ndongwana kwa mambu machoku, akubha ndongwana bhelabhela kwa mambu makolongwa, na jokapi jwangakubha ndongwana kwa mambu machoku, bhelabhela ngacheaweza kubha ndongwana kwa mambu makolongwa.
Bhela anangati mwanganya ngachemwabhi mwalongwana kwa kujemalela hindu ya pundema pani, bho, nane joaweza kukupekeha yela hindu ya chakaka?
Ngati ngachemwabhi bhalongwana kwa hindu yaka mundu jongi, bho, nane joampekya hindu hinu mabhete?

“Njeta mtumika joaweza kubhatumakila mabambo bhabheli, maghambu ananhwakalya jumu na kumpala jongi, au anaakamulana na jumu na kumpoha lihamu jongi. Ngamuwezi kuntumaki Chapanga na kwitumiki mbija kwa papamu.”
Malenganesu ghangi ghaka Yesu
Bhela Mafalisayo pabhajowini malobhi ghanihagha, bhakundongimi Yesu, maghambu bhakabhi bhapala mbija.

Yesu akabhapwaghile, “Mwanganya mulibhona mabhamdu bhamboni palongi ja bhandu, nambu Chapanga ajimanyi mitima jinu. Maghambu chechibhonikana kubha chamboni palongi ja mihu gha bhandu, Chapanga akibhona kubha chihakau.

“Shelia na Malembu gha bhalota bhaka Chapanga ghakatangaziki mbaka chikahi chaka Yohana Mbatizaji. Kutumbu panihapa Malobhi Manyahi gha Ukolongwa waka Chapanga ghatangizwi, na kila mundu aujingi kwa makili.
Nambu kupepwiki namaa kwa kunani kumahunde na pundema kupeta, kuliku hata chindu chimu kichokope mu Shelia kubhowakeka.
“Mwanalomi jokapi joandeka nhwanu waki na kuntogho mbomba jongi, atenda ugone, na jokapi joantogho mbomba joalekini na ndomi waki, atenda ugone.
Mwanahindu yamaheli na Lazalo
“Kukabhi na mundu jumu mwanahindu, jonihoju akabhi awata ingobhu ya mbija yamaheli, na kutenda uwangalalu machobha ghokapi.
Bhelabhela kukabhi na mundu jumu kahochu joalowakika Lazalo, joakabhi na hilonda hyegha jokapi, bhakabhi bhundeta palongi ja pundyangu wa nyumba jaka mwanahindu jola.
Jombi akabhi akatokulya kula imbala yeihabhuka kuhuma panani ja meza jaka mwanahindu jola. Hata nakawa ikaikiki kundambalamba mwilonda yaki.
“Lichobha limu kahochu jola akapotile, na bhatumika bha kunani kwaka Chapanga bhakampeliki mbaka pambipi na Ibulahimu. Na mwanahindu jola akapotile, na kuntagha.
Paakabhi kuwawa, akabhi ang'ahika namaa, akalingiki kunani na kumbona Ibulahimu cha kutali, na Lazalo akabya pambipi jaki.
Bhela akandohiki kwa kujamalila akapwagha, ‘Atati Ibulahimu! Umonila chiha! Untuma Lazalo akajwiha lukonji lwaki mumachi, ahika ahimiya lulimi lwangu, ndandi ning'ahika namaa mu motu ghone!’

“Nambu Ibulahimu akamuyangiki, ‘Mwanango, ukombuka kubha ujomwi kupata mambu manyahi ghaku chikahi cha womi waku, na Lazalo akapatiki mambu mahakau. Na sajenu Lazalo abhi pambani ahekalela, nambu wenga ung'ahakika.

Papamu na bhela kubhi na libhomba likolongwa pachilanda jitu na mwenga, nahuli bhabhabhi kongone anabhapai kulomboka konihoku ngabhiweza, kabheti bhabhabhi konihoku anabhapai kulomboka na kuhika kongone ngabhiweza.’
Bhela mwanahindu akapwaghike, ‘Bhela, atati wangu nukujopa, untuma Lazalo kunyumba ja bhalongu bhangu,
kwa ndandi monihomu mi na bhalongu nhwano. Undeka ajenda akabhalakalya nahuli ngabhihika pandu pani pamang'ahiku.’
“Ibulahimu akamuyangike, ‘Bhalongu bhaku bhabhi na Musa na bhalota bhaka Chapanga, waleka bhajowanya bhombe.’
Mwanahindu akayangike, ‘Ngabhela atati Ibulahimu, nambu ngati mundu anayokiki na kubhajendela, anabhang'anambukaje na kughaleka mahoku ghabhu.’
Nambu Ibulahimu akumpwaghile, ‘Ngati ngachebhunjowane Musa na bhalota bhaka Chapanga, ngabhijetakeli hata ngati mundu anahyokike.’ ”
